redaction: No cookies, tokens, identifiers, message contents or response scalar values; schemas and allowlisted business result codes only.
attribution: Phase page is the event-drain point; task-wide CDP queue can include other open pages/iframe sessions. Do not infer per-page cadence from phase labels. Response bodies unavailable at capture time or for other sessions retain captureError.
format: Curated endpoint contract evidence and action-phase counts; deduplicated from sanitized observations, not raw HAR or runtime logs. OPTIONS and unrelated endpoints omitted.
